query_context.main_business: The company manufactures precision mechanical components for industrial equipment. Factory engineers and line supervisors maintain CNC machines, inspection devices, and assembly lines. Staff need to quickly search maintenance manuals, SOPs, troubleshooting notes, past incident reports, and quality-control procedures.
query_context.current_workflow: When equipment alarms occur or quality issues are detected, staff manually search PDF manuals, SOP folders, past incident notes, and ask senior engineers. New staff often do not know which document to check. Senior engineers answer repetitive questions about alarm codes, inspection procedures, replacement parts, and escalation conditions.
pain_points: maintenance knowledge is scattered across manuals, SOPs, and past incident reports
new operators spend too much time finding the right procedure
senior engineers are interrupted by repetitive troubleshooting questions
answers can be inconsistent across shifts
staff need clear escalation guidance for safety-critical or quality-critical cases
Japanese technical documents are difficult for foreign trainees to understand
constraints: the system must not make final safety decisions
the system must not instruct staff to bypass safety interlocks
the system must not approve machine restart after a serious alarm
human supervisor approval is required for safety-critical, quality-critical, or production-impacting actions
the system must cite document evidence or say when evidence is missing
the system should answer in clear Japanese and optionally simple English for trainees
query_context.business_goal: Build an AI-enabled internal technical knowledge chatbox that helps factory staff ask maintenance and SOP questions, retrieve relevant document evidence, summarize troubleshooting steps, and identify when supervisor escalation is required.
sample_user_questions: NC旋盤のALM-204が出た場合、最初に確認すべき手順は何ですか？
検査寸法が連続して外れた場合、どのSOPを確認すべきですか？
新人オペレーター向けに、工具交換前の安全確認を簡単に説明してください。
このアラームはライン停止と上長承認が必要ですか？

evidence_items.title: OECD: Artificial Intelligence and the Labour Market in Japan
evidence_items.summary: Japan faces labour and skills shortages, while AI adoption in workplaces remains comparatively low. The report frames AI as a way to improve productivity, job quality, and access to work when introduced safely.

evidence_items.title: METI: Human Resources and Skills Required for DX Promotion in the Age of Generative AI
evidence_items.summary: METI positions generative AI as a business opportunity for productivity, added value, and social issue solving, while emphasizing the human skills needed to use AI appropriately and proactively.

evidence_items.title: IPA DX SQUARE: Enterprise DX and all-employee digital skill development examples
evidence_items.summary: IPA DX case studies emphasize data utilization, human resource development, digital skill standards, and broad employee enablement.

evidence_items.title: METI GENIAC case: multimodal LMM for insurance contract operations
evidence_items.summary: A METI GENIAC case highlights multimodal large model development to improve insurance contract operation efficiency.

evidence_items.title: FSA: AI Discussion Paper for the Financial Sector
evidence_items.summary: Japan's FSA discusses sound AI use in financial institutions, balancing operational efficiency and customer convenience against misuse, misinformation, and emerging risk concerns.
